title: Contention tests per shared resource and a red main opens a defect task
body:
Source: Fable history review (class 5 races: 7 fixes / 1220 lines) and pipeline audit item 9 (.krn/runs/arch-review/pipeline.md): 7 red main pushes in 3.7 days, none rerun or acted on. On 2026-11-19 the session-cut eval failed on CI after an orphan worker held index.lock.
Files: test/contention/*.test.ts (new), scripts/ (main watcher), src/ci/ship.ts
Outcome: each shared resource (claims, ship records, worktrees, task records, host slot) has a 4-process contention test; a red main push opens a defect task within one CI run, naming the failing test and the merge that caused it.
Proof: the contention tests run in CI; a seeded red main in a fixture opens exactly one task.
